description: The Presentation Upsell intake questions -- Q1 sales page + checkout page, Q2 VSL (video sales letter) page, plus the two conditional declined-reason follow-ups. Loaded by deck-intake-driver.py in signature mode and appended to the standard deck-intake question bank. These questions mirror the want_teleprompter / teleprompter_declined_reason waiver pattern EXACTLY: required, block_gate, conditional_on for the declined-reason follow-ups, storeOn under pre_presentation_capture.*, flowing into working/copy/intake.json at --complete. The SAME definitions live in deck-intake-questions.json (orders 7.6, 7.61, 7.7, 7.71); this file is the standalone upsell-questions.json the design's §10.3 specifies for signature-mode loading.

questions.prompt: Do you need me to create a sales page and a checkout page to go along with your presentation? (yes / no)
questions.help: Default YES. The sales page + checkout page is a standard upsell deliverable and one of the engine's fail-closed gates. A 'no' is recorded as a CLIENT WAIVER with the client's own words -- it is never inferred from silence and never written by the assistant. A 'no' gates OUT the sales+checkout branch entirely.

value_labels.yes: Yes, build the sales page and checkout page

questions.resolverHint: Default 'yes' when the owner says 'whatever you recommend' or does not answer. Only an explicit 'no' opens the follow-up. Never mark 'no' on the client's behalf; never summarise their reason -- the follow-up answer is stored VERBATIM as the waiver's client_request_quote. A 'no' gates OUT the sales+checkout branch (deck-only or VSL-only run); a 'yes' enables the P-U-SALES-* / P-U-CHECKOUT-* / P-U-FORM-CHECKOUT phases.

questions.prompt: Understood -- no sales page or checkout page. In your own words, why don't you want it? (I record this verbatim so nobody later has to guess.)
questions.help: Asked ONLY when want_sales_checkout is 'no'. The answer is stored word-for-word as the waiver's client_request_quote. There is no default and no assistant-authored fallback: an empty answer must be re-asked.
questions.resolverHint: Auto-skipped whenever want_sales_checkout is 'yes' (the overwhelmingly common path), so the standard interview does not grow. When asked, it BLOCKS --complete: a declined gate with no recorded reason is exactly the self-authored waiver this mechanism exists to prevent.

questions.prompt: Would you like a VSL page, a video sales letter page, to go along with this? (yes / no)
questions.help: Default NO -- a VSL page requires the video to exist (see the VSL video dependency: the VSL page references the hosted webinar/video, so a video must be produced before the page build). Default stays 'no' unless the owner explicitly opts in. A 'yes' is a fail-closed gate; a 'no' is recorded as a CLIENT WAIVER with the client's own words -- it is never inferred from silence and never written by the assistant. A 'no' gates OUT the VSL branch entirely.
questions.resolverHint: Default 'no' (video must exist for a VSL page). Only an explicit 'yes' opens the VSL branch; a 'no' opens the follow-up. Never mark 'no' on the client's behalf; never summarise their reason -- the follow-up answer is stored VERBATIM as the waiver's client_request_quote. A 'yes' enables the P-U-VSL-* phases which wait on the video (V1) before the page build.

questions.prompt: Understood -- no VSL page. In your own words, why don't you want it? (I record this verbatim so nobody later has to guess.)
questions.help: Asked ONLY when want_vsl_page is 'no'. The answer is stored word-for-word as the waiver's client_request_quote. There is no default and no assistant-authored fallback: an empty answer must be re-asked.
questions.resolverHint: Auto-skipped whenever want_vsl_page is 'yes'. When asked, it BLOCKS --complete: a declined gate with no recorded reason is exactly the self-authored waiver this mechanism exists to prevent.

waiver_field_mapping._comment: U026 -- the CONSENT record for the upsell gates. Mirrors the deck-intake waiver_field_mapping. Each gate may be waived ONLY by a record carrying a non-empty client_request_quote. Silence is NOT consent.
